report.explanation: Current gateway telemetry is largely healthy: error_rate 0.001, p95 78ms, no dependency timeouts or pool waiters, INFO 200 logs. Only one trace shows a gateway->inventory call erroring at ~2019ms, but topology shows gateway calls order, not inventory directly, so the span attribution is ambiguous. Insufficient evidence to bound any taxonomy cause; handoff required.
missing_evidence: Order and inventory service traces/metrics for the same window to confirm the failing hop
Gateway error-rate and latency metrics over a longer window to confirm the alert
Logs showing the actual error/exception for the failing inventory call
Confirmation of whether gateway calls inventory directly or only via order
